privacy.metaDescription: How HealthFlow Clinics collects, uses and protects your personal and health data.
privacy.p1: We collect the details needed to provide your care: your name, mobile number, National ID or passport, date of birth, gender, and the medical information recorded during your visits.
privacy.p2: Your health data is used only to provide and coordinate your care, issue prescriptions and invoices, and send you appointment messages. We never sell your data and we do not use it for advertising without your consent.
privacy.p3: We process health data based on your explicit consent, which you can review or withdraw at any time from the Privacy section of your account. Withdrawing consent may limit the services we can provide.
privacy.p4: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is limited to the staff involved in your care, and every access is logged. Medical records are retained for the period required by Egyptian law.
privacy.p5: Under the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law (151/2020) you may request access to, a copy of, correction or erasure of your data. Submit requests from your account; we respond within 30 days.
privacy.p6: For privacy questions contact our Data Protection Officer through any of our clinics.
terms.metaDescription: Terms of use for the HealthFlow Clinics website, booking and patient account.
terms.p1: This site provides information about our clinics and lets you book appointments. Medical content is for general information and is not a substitute for a consultation.
terms.p2: A booking is confirmed once you receive a reference number. Slots awaiting online payment are held for 10 minutes. Please arrive 10 minutes early with your ID.
terms.p3: You can cancel or reschedule from your account within the limits shown there. Late cancellations and missed appointments may be subject to the clinic's policy.
terms.p4: Online payments are processed by HealthPay. Refunds for cancelled prepaid bookings are returned to the original payment method according to the clinic policy.
terms.p5: You are responsible for keeping access to your mobile number. You may request account deletion at any time from your account.
terms.p6: Reviews are moderated before publication and must be honest, respectful and free of personal data.

consentInfo.health_data: Lets the clinic record and use your health information (visits, prescriptions, results) to treat you. Required to book.
consentInfo.messaging: Appointment confirmations and reminders by SMS, WhatsApp or app notifications.
consentInfo.marketing: Occasional offers and health tips. You can withdraw at any time.
consentInfo.telemedicine: Needed for video consultations: you agree to be seen by the doctor over a video call run by an external video service, and understand that some conditions need an in-person examination. Required before joining a video visit.
consentInfo.itqan_sharing: Lets us include a coded reference (never your name, phone or ID) when complaints and low ratings are shared with the ITQAN quality programme, so repeated issues can be tracked. Without it, your feedback is still shared, fully anonymous.
